response.overview: What happens when a ruffian and a girl falls in love? This is the story of a ruffian, who grew up as a street urchin, never learned any manners, lived his life like a dog. And a girl, who grew up in a family of police officers, who taught her to be a upright citizen, who will not tolerate any injustice. Can this love withstand the difference of social outlook?
response.title: Matir Phool
